department: KIT Department of Civil Engineering, Geo and Environmental Sciences

deadline.value: Applications are due 14 days before a doctoral committee meeting; the page gives no fixed dates.

gre_subject.value: The page does not mention a GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: The page does not state the supervisor agreement rule for acceptance.

funding.value: The page does not say how doctoral candidates are funded.

entry_route.value: Acceptance needs a master's degree, a four-year university degree, or a degree that builds on an undergraduate course, in civil engineering, geosciences or environmental sciences with a good grade or better.
entry_route.quote: a course of study which builds on an undergraduate course of study at a university, university of education or at another university with the right to award doctorates

notes: One department doctorate covers civil engineering, geosciences and environmental sciences, so earth and environment are listed as also_fields. Acceptance is applied for at the department before the thesis starts.
